d:
bharti
Patna ke maner men hue pulis enkauntar ke bad upja vivad ab aur gahra gaya hai. enkauntar men mare gae yuvkon ke parijnon aur puliskarmiyon ke bich danapur anumandliy aspatal parisar men jamkar jharap aur hangama huaa, jiske bad sthiti ko sanbhalne aur parijnon ka hal janne patliputr sansad misa bharti khud aspatal pahunchin.
